0022600121.text: The Celtics (1-1, 3rd in the Atlantic, 1 game back) host the Chicago Bulls (1-1, 2nd in the Central, 0.5 games back) as Boston looks to build on its 1-0 home record after a 0-1 road start. Devin Carter is out for Boston with illness, and Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Boston won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 124-105 home win on February 11, 2026.
